abstract.para: Before you continue, create an administrator account or configure authentication for the &rootuser; user.

topic.para: Before you can continue with the installation, you need to create an administrator account or configure the authentication for the &rootuser; user.

section.title: Administrator account
section.para: To improve security, &rootuser; login is disabled in &productname; by default. Instead, an administrator user is used as main login account. This administrator can run administrative commands with &sudo;.
To create an administrator account, tick the checkbox Define an administrator user and enter the necessary user details.

listitem.para: Full name of the administrator user.
A user name. Only use lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9) and the characters . (dot), - (hyphen) and _ (underscore). Avoid other special characters and accented characters.
Paste one or more public SSH keys to enable passwordless login with SSH. To add a key, press or . To remove a key, press or . To navigate between keys, use the and arrows.

important.title: No SSH &rootuser; access
important.para: SSH access for &rootuser; is disabled by default. Therefore it is strongly recommended to create a system user. The first system user is granted &sudo; privileges automatically and can also be used for accessing &cockpit;.

section.title: root user
section.para: Configure the authentication methods for the &rootuser;. You can use a secure password, an SSH public key or both.

listitem.para: The &rootuser; login is disabled and the administrator uses &sudo; for all administrative tasks.
The &rootuser; can log in with a password. Configure a strong password.
The &rootuser; can log in with an SSH public key. Paste one or more public SSH keys. To add a key, press or . To remove a key, press or . To navigate between different keys, use the and arrows.
The &rootuser; user can log in both with a password and SSH key(s). Configure both as described above.
